about: The practice week (Sunday, Oct 11 to Saturday, Oct 17) is this app's own proposal, not NHS content. It is deliberately easier than week 1: short jogs and easy sets so you can learn the rep standards, the counter and the timer before the plan starts. Nothing in it changes week 1, and the real start stays Monday, October 19.
banner: Practice week: easier than the plan, to learn the movements and the app.

run.title: Practice run
run.summary: 6 × 30 sec easy jogs, 90 sec walks between
run.note: Slower than you think. This is about finding an easy, conversational jog and trying the session timer, not about fitness.

A.title: Practice strength A
A.focus: Learn the rep standards with easy sets, and try the rep counter.

movement.detail: 2 easy sets, stopping with 3-4 clean reps left
movement.how: Read the rep standard first. If you can't do 3 clean reps, do the easier version listed below.

B.title: Practice strength B
B.focus: Optional rep check: one set each to the last clean rep. These numbers can become your starting point.

accessories.name: Bodyweight squat
accessories.how: Take 3 sec on the way down, to a depth you control.

accessories.name: Hollow hold
accessories.how: Lower back pressed to the floor. Bend your knees to make it easier.
